what: Rounded face panels float without gravity, bumping into the panel walls and each other (like billiards). They start from the four corners (inside 12%) at short side × 0.36 speed and bounce with restitution 0.9 · friction 0.04. When they slow down or run parallel to a wall they revive over 2 seconds at short side × 0.3 speed · 0.3 tilt, so they keep going forever. On impact they squash up to 7% toward the hit and return (frequency 18 · damping 0.34), and 4~9 ink drops splash from the impact point, stretch and shrink over 0.5~0.75s, then vanish. The face inside each panel rotates on its own (±12°/s, drag 0.18). Stops when offscreen

options.[data-fx-part=ball]: Round panel that drifts around (child). Its size is the panel width — it does not exceed the short side × 0.36. Its first child spins in place
options.--fx-burst: Bubble color, can differ per panel. Default --kf-accent
options.fx:play: Send it and it restarts from the corner
